newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bankruptcies down seven pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bankruptcies down seven pct in July.

text.p: Company bankruptcies in Belgium fell by seven percent to 607 in July compared with July 1996, Belgian trade and company data group Infotrade said in a statement on Thursday.

But in the first seven months a total of 4,703 companies went bankrupt, up 7.15 percent from the same 1996 period. Infotrade said that if the current trend persisted, the number of bankruptcies could rise to 8,000 for the year as a whole.
In July 1,332 jobs had been lost as a result of the bankruptcies, below the monthly average for the year to date of 2,195.
